title: 第247章 水火不侵第246章 着急的魅姬
slug: 听我解释真不是你们想的那样
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！第一卷：默认第247章水火不侵？（..la）“运气好，运气好！侥幸罢了！”陆沉咧嘴一笑。
他嘴上谦虚，心里却早就乐开了花。
现在柳如烟在他心里，几乎默认属于大帝级人物了。
现在她一本正经地夸自己战力超群，这个感觉……爽！实在是太爽了！
“来，给你介绍一下，这位是大离药王宗的叶冰，这位是碧姬。”
“叶冰吗？我听说过你，没想到你也来这中州了。”
“嗯，想着来历练历练。”
柳如烟闻言，便不再多说。
因为她记忆里面根本就没有这一号人。
或许上一世早期确实有印象，但到了后面，叫叶冰的，直接查无此人了，应该是泯然众人矣了，不用太过在意。
倒是这碧姬……
她不是妖族黑蛟王的妖后吗？怎么也跑中州来了，看上去还和陆沉他们挺熟悉的，难不成自己的记忆真的出现了问题不成？
“如烟，现在这毒瘴已经被碧姬解开了，现在咱们快进去看看吧！”
“好！”
众人对视一眼，便不再犹豫，同时踏入碧姬开辟出来的道路之中。
众人沿着通道一路向深处走去，越往里走，空气中的灵气便越发浓郁，但那种浓郁与外界不同。
一半炽热如火，一半冰寒刺骨，两种截然相反的气息在空气中交织碰撞，每一次呼吸都让人觉得肺部一半在被灼烧、一半在被冻结。
“到了。”
碧姬停下脚步，侧身让开视线。
面前是一片约莫百丈方圆的空地，毒瘴在这里像是被某种无形的力量阻隔在外，形成了一片纯净的真空地带。

而这片空地的正中央，一口泉眼静静地躺在那里。
泉眼不大，直径不过三尺，但泉水分明呈现出截然不同的两种颜色。
左半边是炽烈的赤红，水面翻滚着细小的气泡，每一次破裂都溅起一缕火苗，将周围的空气灼得扭曲。
右半边是澄澈的冰蓝，水面平静如镜，却有丝丝缕缕的寒气从水面上升起，在泉边凝结成一圈晶莹的霜花。
两色泉水在泉眼中缓缓流转，互不相容却又彼此呼应，每一次流转都在水面上划出一道弧形的法则涟漪。
冰火两……
而在泉眼四周，密密麻麻地生长着一圈灵草。
这些灵草的种类驳杂得令人咋舌，它们散发着惊人灵气的奇花异草，并且每一株都品相极好，年份少说也有数千年，药力之强，光是站在旁边吸一口逸散出来的药香，便觉得浑身经脉都在微微发烫！
最引人注目的是泉眼正前方两株并肩而生的灵草。
“八角玄冰……烈火杏娇……”柳如烟的声音都有些发颤。
但陆沉却是一脸的嫌弃。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book lovers: Listen to my explanation, it’s really not what you think! Volume 1: Default Chapter 247 Invulnerable to Water and Fire? (..la) "Good luck, good luck! It's just a fluke!" Lu Chen grinned.
He was humble on the outside, but he was already happy in his heart.
Now in his heart, Liu Ruyan almost belonged to the emperor-level figure by default.
Now she is praising her superior combat power in a serious manner. This feeling... feels good! It’s so cool!
"Here, let me introduce you. This is Ye Bing from the Dali Medicine King Sect, and this is Bi Ji."
"Ye Bing? I've heard of you, but I didn't expect you to come to Zhongzhou too."
"Well, I thought I'd give it a try."
When Liu Ruyan heard this, he said no more.
Because there is no such person in her memory at all.
Perhaps there was indeed an impression in the early stages of the previous life, but later on, the person named Ye Bing was no longer found. He should have disappeared from everyone, so don't pay too much attention to it.
But this Brigitte...
Isn't she the demon queen of the demon clan's black dragon king? Why did he come to Zhongzhou? He seems to be quite familiar with Lu Chen and the others. Could it be that there is something wrong with his memory?
"Ruyan, now Bi Ji has solved this poisonous miasma, let's go in and take a look!"
"Okay!"
Everyone looked at each other, then no longer hesitated, and stepped into the path opened by Brigitte.
Everyone walked deeper along the passage. As they walked deeper, the spiritual energy in the air became richer, but the richness was different from the outside world.
Half as hot as fire, half as cold as ice, the two completely opposite breaths intertwined and collided in the air. Every breath made people feel that their lungs were half burning and half freezing.
"Arrived."
Brigitte stopped and turned aside to look away.
In front of him was an open space about a hundred feet in diameter, where the poisonous miasma seemed to be blocked by some invisible force, forming a pure vacuum zone.
And in the center of this clearing, a spring lay quietly there.
The spring is not big, only three feet in diameter, but the spring water clearly shows two completely different colors.
The left half was blazing red, and the water surface was rolling with tiny bubbles. Every time it burst, a wisp of flames splashed out, distorting the surrounding air.
The right half is clear ice blue, and the water is as calm as a mirror, but there are wisps of cold air rising from the water, condensing into a circle of crystal frost flowers by the spring.
The two colors of spring water flow slowly in the spring, incompatible with each other but echoing each other. Each flow draws an arc-shaped ripple on the water.
Ice and fire...
Around the spring, a circle of spiritual grass grows densely.
The variety of these spiritual herbs is astonishing. They are exotic flowers and herbs that exude astonishing aura, and each one is in excellent condition. It is at least thousands of years old. The medicinal power is so strong that just by standing next to it and taking a sip of the medicinal fragrance that escapes, you will feel that the meridians all over your body are slightly hot!
The most eye-catching thing is the two spiritual grasses growing side by side right in front of the spring.
"Bajiao Xuanbing... Liehuo Xingjiao..." Liu Ruyan's voice was trembling.
But Lu Chen had a look of disgust on his face.
